lifecycles._note: NEW API wave 2026-07-15 (SPEC-DIFF-20260715 §2⑥): Address Group — 8 new endpoints on networking/security-group (security-group 1.1). FREE logical resource: account/region-scoped, NO VPC/SG prerequisite (confirmed live — created in a bare state with zero address groups). FULL lifecycle VALIDATED LIVE 2026-07-15, every endpoint 2xx: create 201 -> list 200 -> show 200 -> set 200 -> add_addresses 200 -> list addresses 200 -> remove_addresses 200 -> delete 204 -> show-after-delete 404 (AddressGroupNotFound, clean error JSON). Response envelope: create/show wrap in $.address_group.{id,name,addresses,address_count,address_limit,state:ACTIVE,...}; list wraps in $.address_groups[] + count; add/remove/list-addresses return flat {addresses:[...]} (+count on list). Body models: AddressGroupCreateRequest {name REQ, addresses opt array[cidr], description opt, tags opt array[Tag]} — tags accepted live so engine owner-tag injection applies; AddressGroupSetRequest {description opt} (set returns 200 with EMPTY body {} — do not capture from it); add/remove BOTH use AddressGroupCidrsAddRequest {addresses REQ array[cidr]}. QUIRK (conformance candidate): create response said address_limit:5 but list/show of the same group immediately said address_limit:1000 — inconsistent limit reporting between envelopes. Delete of a group whose addresses are referenced by an SG rule (remote_address_group_id) untested — likely 409/422; this lifecycle never wires the group into a rule so delete is safe.

steps.name: list-address-groups
steps._note: listaddressgroups: unconditional 200 even with zero groups ({address_groups:[],count:0}) — light-runnable anchor. Optional query filters: size/page/sort/id/name.

steps.name: create-address-group
steps._note: createaddressgroup: 201 live. Envelope $.address_group.id. name REQ (only required field); addresses/description/tags optional. tags [] present so the engine injects owner/run/ttl tags (accepted live 2026-07-15).

steps.name: set-address-group
steps._note: setaddressgroup: 200 live. AddressGroupSetRequest carries ONLY description (name/addresses not updatable here — addresses via add/remove endpoints). Returns 200 with empty JSON body {}.

steps.name: add-address-group-cidrs
steps._note: addaddressgroupcidrs: 200 live, returns the FULL merged address list {addresses:[...3 cidrs]}. Duplicate-add behavior untested (likely idempotent or 409).

steps.name: list-address-group-cidrs
steps._note: listaddressgroupcidrs: 200 live, {addresses:[...],count:3} after the add. Optional filters size/page/sort/address.

steps.name: remove-address-group-cidrs
steps._note: removeaddressgroupcidrs: 200 live, returns remaining {addresses:[...2 cidrs]}. Same body model as add (AddressGroupCidrsAddRequest, addresses REQ).

steps.name: delete-address-group
steps._note: deleteaddressgroup: 204 live, empty body. Post-delete GET returns 404 scp-network.securitygroup.addressgroup.not-found (verified — no lingering resource).

steps.name: show-address-group-after-delete
steps._note: Deletion proof: 404 AddressGroupNotFound with clean JSON error (verified live 2026-07-15). Separate group so it never blocks teardown accounting.
